commitResults.messageTitle: Add mark function and add an agent skill
Add todo, deadline, event three types of task

commitResults.messageBody:
Use enum to represent the task type
Make Task abstract to prevent direct instantiation
Replace string comparisons with enum-based switch handling

Add file-based storage for saving task details and completion states.

Load saved tasks when Windy starts and save changes after task updates.

Add isolated UI regression tests for saving and reloading tasks.

Parse deadline and event dates as LocalDate values and display them
using a consistent English format. Add the find command to show
unfinished deadlines and events relevant to a specified date.

Update storage loading to handle invalid saved dates and add UI
regression tests for date parsing, validation, and task filtering.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: separate UI, parsing, and task list responsibilities
commitResults.messageBody:
Extract user interaction into Ui, centralize command parsing and
validation in Parser, and encapsulate task operations in TaskList.

Update UI regression tests to cover the new find summary and unmark
validation message.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor: organize classes into Java packages
commitResults.messageBody:
Group classes by responsibility to make the project
structure easier to navigate and maintain.

commitResults.messageTitle: Configure Gradle to build and run Windy
Add JUnit tests for Parser and TaskList

commitResults.messageBody:
Document public calsses and methods, overriden methodscommand types,
and non-trivial private helpers to improve code readability and API documentation.

commitResults.messageTitle: Adopt SE-EDU coding and Git standards
commitResults.messageBody:
Project-specific conventions are not encoded in the repository, and the
existing Java code contains naming, import-order, and formatting
inconsistencies.

Add reusable Java and Git standard skills and require agents to apply
them. Align the current Java sources and tests with the Java standard
without changing console behavior.

Track both skills while keeping other local agent files ignored.

commitResults.messageTitle: Rename date-based find command to avoid keyword conflict
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace the existing `find <date>` command with `date <date>`, freeing the
`find` keyword for task description searches. Update related validation
messages and UI test cases accordingly.

Implement the `find <keyword>` command to search task descriptions while
including both completed and incomplete matches.

Improve method naming and add Javadoc to comply with the Java coding standard.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor command handling and keyword search
commitResults.messageBody:
Move command-specific execution out of Windy and let Parser create
executable command objects. Keep the main loop focused on orchestration.
Preserve existing console and persistence behavior.

Make keyword matching case-insensitive so find behaves as users expect.
Add command and search regression tests. Align date formatter declarations
with the configured Checkstyle rules.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Checkstyle plugin to Intellij and Gradle

commitResults.messageBody:
The UI repeats print calls when displaying related message lines.
Add a varargs helper to centralize multi-line output while preserving
the existing console text and order.

Replace the console-only entry point with a responsive JavaFX chat
interface while preserving the existing command and storage behavior.

- Define reusable layouts with FXML and style them with CSS
- Connect GUI input to Windy's command responses
- Show welcome and farewell messages and close after `bye`
- Add tests for GUI-facing response behavior
